values.note: MWCD 2024 rate sheet, column 'Leesville Southfork': electric $46, primitive $42; add $10 a night Fri-Sat May 21-Oct 31 and on the 3 days around major holidays. Newer rates aren't published: this campground isn't on MWCD's reservation engine, you pay at the on-site office.
Choose an open site on arrival and pay at the on-site office.

booking.source: https://www.mwcd.org/places/leesville-lake/ ('available on a first come, first served basis. Upon arrival, guests can select an available site and pay at the office located on site'), read 2026-10-31

note: Muskingum Watershed Conservancy District campground on Leesville Lake, on the south shore just east of the dam off Deer Road, Bowerston. Sites 5-25 back the shore. Campground phone answers April-October; off-season questions go to Atwood Lake Park, 330-343-6780. --Claude
summary: First-come pay-at-office and phone confirmed; added fees $46-56 from MWCD's 2024 rate sheet (primitive $42 not the base). Pin OK. Season, amperage, site count not stated.
flags: Local park: the public gets an ordinary night first come, pay at the on-site office (MWCD Leesville page). Operated by MWCD through Atwood Lake Park; the South Fork Marina next door is private.

WATERFRONT: stored lakefront holds. Lot map draws electric sites 005-025 backing the shore, MWCD's rate sheet sells 'Basic, waterfront, electric' seasonal lots here, imagery at the pin shows rigs along the shoreline. DAM CHECK: dam is ~500 m NW across the cove but the campground is on the LAKE side of it, pad DEM 300 m against ~292 m at the shore/open water, so not below the dam.
Pin 40.4658,-81.1905 OK: inside the loops on the imagery.
Rate age: the only MWCD rate sheet found is 2024. No 2025/2026 figure; Campendium's undated $35 was not used. reserve.mwcd.org not tried (behind AWS WAF, and this campground is first come anyway).

MWCD's text says 'Limited electric campsites available' but its lot map shows electric lots numbered up to 062 against only seven primitive (P1-P7), plus camper cabins. The 2024 sheet also sells seven-month seasonal lots here ($2,800-3,150): the seasonal share of those lots isn't published. Imagery shows many rigs along the shore. sites.count not written for that reason.

Season left unset: MWCD says only 'For questions April 1 - October 31 call Leesville South Fork Campground at 740-269-9214; October 31 - April 1 call Atwood Park'. Phone 740-269-9214 confirmed by that line; Lake office 330-343-6780.
